name: Far right
summary: Far-right politics, as shown by the European populist radical right, combines nativism and national sovereignty (restrictive immigration, assimilation, welfare for nationals, rejection of supranational unions) with law-and-order politics, traditional-family values, hostility to political elites and a call for direct democracy. Its economics is not fixed: parties mix market economy, protectionism and welfare for natives.
scope: A family. Read as the independent programmes of six European parties: AfD (Germany, 2017), FPOe (Austria, 2011), Sweden Democrats (2019), PVV (Netherlands, 2023), National Rally (France, 2022 presidential measures) and Vox (Spain, 2023). Mudde's scholarship identifies what unites them. A position counts only where several branches state it and none states the opposite. Excludes fascism, neo-Nazism, the alt-right, neo-fascism, white nationalism and other entries with their own audit, and non-European branches.

reduce-immigration.rationale: AfD allows only moderate qualified legal immigration, the FPOe says Austria is not a country of immigration, the SD wants it kept limited, the PVV an asylum stop and restricted labour and student migration, the RN an end to settlement immigration, Vox legal and controlled only.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: SD calls for an assimilation policy in which immigrants give up their original culture, the AfD calls assimilation the most advanced form of integration under a predominant German culture, the RN ties nationality to assimilation, and the FPOe and Vox require integration and adaptation.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: The FPOe ties the right to stay and citizenship to speaking German, the AfD links citizenship to language and culture, and the SD makes learning Swedish a condition of citizenship.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: The PVV, RN and Vox each reserve social benefits for nationals or legal residents (end of benefit export, 5 years of work for foreigners, aid tied to legal residence), the AfD limits benefits for EU newcomers to those who contributed for four years, and the FPOe puts social housing and prosperity first for Austrians.

nation-first.rationale: Austria First (FPOe), Nederlanders weer op 1 (PVV), priorite nationale (RN), the interests of Spaniards first (Vox), Swedish interests (SD) and German sovereignty and interests (AfD) all put the nation's interest ahead of supranational commitments.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Every programme defends national culture and tradition: the AfD's predominant German culture, the FPOe's national identity, the SD's cultural heritage, the PVV's Dutch traditions and Vox's national identity.

open-borders.rationale: Each branch demands border control and rejects open-border policy (PVV, AfD, RN, Vox, FPOe, SD), so an eventual open-borders world is rejected.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: The AfD would scrap citizenship by birth so children of foreigners get citizenship only if a parent is a citizen, and the RN would abolish the droit du sol; the other programmes are silent.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: The SD requires a long period of residence before citizenship and the AfD wants significantly higher naturalisation requirements; neither states a fixed number of years in the programme.

national-self-determination.rationale: The SD grants every nation the same freedom it claims (with caveats for nations that cannot sustain a state), and the FPOe commits to a Europe of self-determined peoples and to South Tyrol's self-determination.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: All six branches reject a supranational union: AfD (Europe of nation states), FPOe, SD (intergovernmental only), PVV (Nexit referendum), RN (sovereignty) and Vox (rejects federalism).

empower-international-orgs.rationale: The SD calls intergovernmental cooperation fully sufficient, the AfD wants a constructive but non-interfering UN, and the FPOe accepts UN mandates only for voluntary missions; none asks for more UN power.

national-law-over-international.rationale: The FPOe says constitutional principles of member states take absolute priority over Community law and Vox defends the primacy of the constitution over European law; the PVV also plans an opt-out from EU asylum rules.

common-currency.rationale: The AfD proposes a referendum on the euro and calls the single currency unsuited to heterogeneous states, and the SD wants to keep the national krona; the other programmes do not state a currency position.

free-trade.rationale: The SD is basically positive to free trade and the AfD wants lower trade barriers, while the RN wants free-trade agreements reviewed and Vox demands preference for domestic producers.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: The RN and Vox want protection from unfair foreign competition while the AfD wants lower trade barriers and the SD is basically pro free trade.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: The AfD wants trade agreements to respect German social and environmental standards, the RN bans imports not meeting French production standards, and Vox demands equal conditions for foreign products.

traditional-family.rationale: The AfD (traditional family as guiding principle), FPOe (family of man and woman as nucleus) and Vox (family the basic institution) state it directly, and the SD calls the nuclear family usually best while supporting other forms.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: The FPOe rejects a legal institution for same-sex relations and Vox opposes the family laws, but the SD leaves marriage for gays to religious communities and gives same rights otherwise, and the PVV names LGBT equality as a core value.

abortion-legal.rationale: The AfD opposes downplaying abortion and public support for it, Vox would repeal the abortion law, and the SD criticises the view that fetuses lack value; neither calls for a total ban and the PVV and RN are silent.

gender-social-construct.rationale: The AfD ends gender research and gender mainstreaming, the FPOe rejects gender mainstreaming, the SD asserts innate biological sex differences, Vox rejects gender ideology and the PVV condemns gender madness in schools.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: The SD calls sex and sexual orientation inherited traits and rejects the claim of social construction, and Vox rejects trans ideology.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: The AfD calls gender quotas unproductive and unfair, the FPOe rejects quotas, the SD wants no special treatment by sex, and Vox would abolish the equality ministry.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: The FPOe wants equal opportunities regardless of gender and the SD formal equality with no state view on how men and women should live, so neither writes distinct public roles into law.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: The SD says persecution of people for their sexual orientation is reprehensible and should be punished hard, and the PVV lists homosexual and LGBT equality among its basic values.

women-suffrage.rationale: The SD affirms universal and equal suffrage and the equal worth and rights of men and women, the PVV defends the equality of men and women, and the FPOe wants equal opportunity.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The SD affirms each person's inviolable value and equality before law, and the FPOe the dignity of man, but both tie full rights to citizenship so the answer is not the strongest.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: The SD says sex differences in choices are not discrimination or an oppressive gender order, and the FPOe says statistical inequalities cannot be evened out by wronging individuals.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: The PVV ends preferential policy for groups, the SD allows neither negative nor positive discrimination by ethnicity, and the FPOe rejects preferential treatment to offset discrimination.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: The PVV ends voorkeursbeleid and positive discrimination, and the SD allows no positive discrimination on ethnic grounds in the labour market.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The SD calls skin colour and ethnicity irrelevant and wants equal rights for all citizens, and the FPOe grants asylum to the racially persecuted.

racial-franchise.rationale: The SD wants universal and equal suffrage for all citizens and the FPOe places the vote among the rights of every citizen.

property-franchise.rationale: The SD defends universal and equal suffrage, and the FPOe lists the vote among every citizen's rights.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: The SD says only Swedish citizens should vote in public elections and the FPOe calls the vote a right of citizens.

islam-incompatible.rationale: The AfD says Islam does not belong to Germany, the PVV says the Netherlands is not an Islamic country, the SD calls Islam the religion hardest to coexist with Western culture, while the RN names only Islamist ideologies.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: The SD explicitly rejects cultural relativism and ranks cultures by their record on rights and welfare, the AfD wants German culture predominant, and the PVV puts Dutch culture and secular law first.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: The SD says a minimum of language, culture and religion differences helps cohesion and the AfD and FPOe attack multiculturalism, but they speak of cultural rather than racial diversity.

patriotic-education.rationale: The SD wants schools to stress respect for the Swedish heritage and the FPOe wants schools to convey the community's values and traditions; neither mentions flag or anthem.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: The PVV ends the left's hatred of historical heroes and keeps Zwarte Piet, and Vox would repeal memory laws and honour all who fought for Spain.

religious-exemptions.rationale: The AfD would scrap religious exceptions to the slaughter-stunning rule, the PVV and RN ban slaughter without stunning, and the SD says religious and non-religious citizens obey the same laws.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: The SD says religious and non-religious citizens follow the same laws, the PVV puts secular law first, the AfD refuses special rights for Muslim pupils and the FPOe grants public status only to churches accepting the constitution.

separate-church-state.rationale: The FPOe endorses separation of church and state, while the SD says the state cannot be religiously neutral and should give Christianity a special place and the PVV wants Judeo-Christian roots in the constitution.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: The PVV puts secular law above sharia, the AfD calls sharia incompatible with the legal order and the SD says religious and non-religious citizens obey the same laws.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: The PVV protects the right to leave one's faith (geloofsverlater) and the FPOe protects freedom from religious doctrines.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: The AfD says criticism and satire of religion including Islam are protected opinion, and the SD says religions must be open to criticism like political ideologies.

clerical-rule.rationale: The AfD says sharia is incompatible with the legal order and the SD and FPOe commit to democratic rule where power comes from the people.

women-must-cover.rationale: The AfD demands a ban on full-body veils in public and the PVV bans Islamic headscarves in government buildings.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: The AfD wants larger families instead of mass immigration, the FPOe a family policy centred on births because Austria is not a country of immigration, Vox a national natality plan, and the RN tax and loan benefits that grow with each child.

duties-before-rights.rationale: The SD says rights must be weighed by duties and can be lost, and the FPOe pairs citizens' rights with obligations.

work-for-welfare.rationale: The SD links rights to duties and work-worthwhile, the FPOe calls for measures against welfare abuse, and the RN conditions benefits on 5 years of work for foreigners.

cut-welfare.rationale: The SD defends a universal solidarity welfare model, the FPOe a social state, the PVV and RN raise pensions and benefits for nationals, so they restrict welfare to nationals rather than cut it.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: The SD wants a general solidarity-financed welfare model and the FPOe public health care without class distinctions, against targeting only the poorest.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: The SD treats voluntary groups as a supplement and wants state and municipalities to finance care, and the FPOe wants a social state.

universal-healthcare.rationale: The SD wants tax-financed healthcare according to need, the FPOe best possible public healthcare without class distinctions, the PVV abolishes the deductible and adds dental, and the RN invests in public hospitals.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: The AfD calls animals sentient creatures, the FPOe wants animals protected from suffering, the SD wants no animal subjected to unnecessary suffering, and the PVV and RN seek stunning before slaughter.

animal-use-humane.rationale: The SD allows animals in human ownership with respect and no unnecessary suffering, the AfD regulates hunting and farming humanely, and the PVV supports farmers.

direct-votes.rationale: The AfD wants Swiss-style referenda, the FPOe direct democracy, the SD more decisive referendums, the PVV a binding referendum, the RN a citizens' initiative referendum and Vox a referendum on immigration.

democracy-best.rationale: The AfD, FPOe, SD and PVV all declare democratic popular sovereignty the highest principle and fight anti-democratic movements; whether voters 'choose badly' is not discussed.

one-party-rule.rationale: The AfD, FPOe and SD commit to free, multi-party democracy with free elections and the SD combats anti-democratic movements.

suppress-opposition.rationale: The AfD, FPOe and SD commit to freedom of assembly, association and expression, though Vox would ban parties seeking to destroy Spanish unity.

party-controls-media.rationale: The FPOe wants media law preventing monopolies and manipulation, the SD defends press freedom, the AfD wants the licence-fee broadcaster made voluntary, and Vox a freedom of expression chapter.

total-state.rationale: The SD says the state in its ideal form has no interests of its own and only implements the nation's will, and the FPOe says freedom rules out all forms of repression.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: The AfD, FPOe and SD all stress rule of law and equality before the law, and the PVV rejects an all-powerful government.

separated-powers.rationale: The AfD wants to guarantee separation of powers and the FPOe names power-separating constitutional principles.

consent-of-governed.rationale: The SD calls it its most central principle that all public power derives from the people, and the AfD and FPOe stress popular sovereignty and self-determination.

proportional-representation.rationale: The FPOe asks for free, fair, direct proportional representation and the RN wants proportional representation introduced.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: The AfD attacks a class of career politicians, the PVV says the elite governs, and Vox attacks the partitocratic consensus; the FPOe and SD do not make the claim.

public-service-media.rationale: The PVV ends NPO funding, the RN privatises public broadcasting, and the AfD would turn the compulsory broadcasting fee into a voluntary one.

decide-locally.rationale: The SD, AfD and FPOe favour subsidiarity and federalism, while Vox wants the autonomous communities' powers returned to the central state.

right-to-secede.rationale: The FPOe backs South Tyrol's self-determination and the SD backs peoples with a historic right to independence, while Vox treats secession as a crime against Spanish unity.

conscription.rationale: The AfD and FPOe want compulsory male military or alternative service and the SD wants general conscription, while Vox only wants a voluntary reserve service and the RN and PVV do not mention it.

equal-conscription.rationale: The AfD and FPOe would conscript men only and the SD gives women only voluntary armed service, so none applies it equally.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: The FPOe wants neutrality outside military pacts and the SD seeks non-alignment, while the AfD says NATO membership serves Germany and Vox wants NATO cover extended to Ceuta and Melilla.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: The FPOe insists on neutrality outside military pacts and the SD seeks non-alignment, but the AfD and Vox keep NATO membership.

collective-defense.rationale: The AfD and Vox accept NATO as a defensive alliance, while the FPOe and SD reject binding military pacts.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: The SD would not go below the UN aid level, while the PVV stops all development aid and the AfD, FPOe and Vox tie aid to self-help or migration cooperation.

non-intervention.rationale: The AfD favours non-interference in the internal affairs of other states, though the SD backs domestic opposition abroad when democracy is at stake.

territorial-expansion.rationale: The SD says no state may violate or enslave another people, and the AfD rejects interference abroad and sees NATO as defensive.

national-mission.rationale: The SD says no nation has the moral right to change another nation's culture and the AfD favours non-interference.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: The SD grants every nation the same rights and says no nation may subjugate another, and the AfD favours non-interference.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: The SD calls the duty to obey democratically made laws central and the FPOe stresses law and order and civic obligations.

revolution-justified.rationale: The SD prefers responsible reforms to revolutionary tendencies, and the AfD, FPOe and PVV pursue change through elections and referendums.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: The SD rejects Marxism and class dictatorship in favour of democracy, and the FPOe commits to democracy and the rule of law.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: The FPOe, AfD and SD favour a market economy, while the RN renationalises motorways and the PVV removes acute care from market competition.

social-market-economy.rationale: The FPOe calls for a market economy with social responsibility, the AfD ties minimum wages to the social market economy, and the SD wants a responsible regulated market economy with solidarity welfare.

central-planning.rationale: The FPOe, AfD and SD commit to market economies.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: The FPOe, AfD and SD commit to a market economy built on wages, performance and property.

property-fundamental.rationale: The FPOe protects private property, the SD calls ownership a necessary condition of development, and the PVV rejects expropriating farmers.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: The AfD abolishes wealth and inheritance taxes, the RN scraps the real estate wealth tax and Vox the succession tax, though the PVV taxes bank windfall profits.

tax-inheritance.rationale: The AfD wants inheritance tax abolished, Vox pushed a bill to abolish it, and the RN abolishes direct inheritance tax for modest and middle-class families.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: The PVV removes VAT on groceries and cuts it on energy and the RN cuts VAT on energy to 5.5 percent.

public-ownership.rationale: The SD wants infrastructure, electricity and water under strong public control, the RN renationalises motorways and the PVV merges NS and ProRail, though the AfD is wary of public-private ties.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: The SD allows private providers within publicly funded services while the PVV bans profit payouts in care.

local-essentials-public.rationale: The SD wants water and electricity distribution under strong public control and the RN renationalises motorways.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: The AfD repays national debt, the FPOe wants a balanced budget over the cycle and the SD respects the budget surplus target; the PVV and RN do not state it.

farm-price-support.rationale: The RN guarantees farmers fair prices, the FPOe wants fair product prices and the PVV an honest price for farmers.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: The FPOe, RN, PVV and Vox all champion industry and reindustrialisation.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The SD, FPOe, PVV, RN and Vox all assign the state healthcare, pensions, and social protection beyond defence, justice and property.

state-harmful.rationale: The SD calls the state necessary and the FPOe and PVV want a stronger state for security and welfare.

taxation-theft.rationale: The SD says tax revenue must fund welfare and the FPOe lists contributions as a citizen's obligation.

private-courts-defense.rationale: The SD puts justice and defence under state control and the AfD and FPOe call for a stronger state police, army and courts.

results-over-ideology.rationale: The SD takes a pragmatic results-oriented approach and the FPOe wants economic policy free from ideological reservations.

empower-police-military.rationale: The PVV adds 10,000 police, the RN 85,000 prison places and more magistrates and defence spending, the AfD stronger law enforcement and army, the FPOe best equipment for police and army, the SD more resources and powers, and Vox higher defence spending.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: The PVV demands high minimum sentences, the RN restores minimum sentences, and the AfD sets minimum jail terms for attacks on officials.

rehabilitation.rationale: The PVV wants strict regimes and full sentences, the RN no sentence reductions, the AfD and SD put victims before offenders, though the FPOe also names reintegration.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The PVV scraps the climate law, the AfD would abolish the renewable energy act and energy saving rules, Vox repeals the climate change law, and the RN stops wind projects.

limit-growth.rationale: The SD says growth is necessary but must be balanced with the environment, and the PVV, AfD and Vox reject growth-limiting climate policy.

expand-nuclear.rationale: The AfD, PVV, RN, SD and Vox support nuclear power but the FPOe rejects it.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: The PVV keeps coal and gas plants and expands North Sea gas and oil, Vox repeals the climate law to use national resources, and the SD accepts fossil fuels in the transition.

gm-crops.rationale: The FPOe wants agriculture free of genetically manipulated organisms, and the AfD approves gene technology only after thorough testing.

future-generations.rationale: The SD's stewardship principle says to hand the planet on in no worse state, and the FPOe wants an intact environment for future generations.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: The SD values cultural heritage as social glue and the FPOe and PVV preserve cultural heritage and traditions.

minority-language-support.rationale: The SD gives national minorities far-reaching cultural autonomy and the FPOe protects historical minorities, while Vox attacks regional language rules and the PVV rejects Arabic and Turkish government information.

single-official-language.rationale: The AfD, FPOe and PVV make the national language central to schools, while the SD and FPOe protect minority languages.
